title: Public marketplaces support cross-category supplier discovery
summary: Public marketplace catalogues can support supplier longlisting and price triangulation across industrial materials, components and services.

title: Commodity markets provide index evidence for raw-material clauses
summary: Independent commodity series provide an evidence base for should-cost models and symmetrical contract price-adjustment mechanisms.

title: Public tenders expose comparable industrial demand and award signals
summary: Tender and award records can identify alternative suppliers and comparable specifications for manufacturing procurement teams.
